item.title: Lecture One | Technology, AI, and Consciousness | Stimulant Art Exhibition — Fri Nov 13, 7:30 PM — Laguna Lab
item.description:
Apocalypse Studio presents the first lecture in their 2 part series during their major solo art exhibition.
The Apocalypse Studio uses AI every day, and is intimately familiar with its benefits. At the same time, AI is not a replacement for human creativity or human thought — but why not, specifically? What are humans doing when they think and create, and how is this different from what machines do when responding to prompts or using “agents” to accomplish tasks? Apocalypse Studio will use artworks and a large blackboard to discuss the differences between human and machine consciousness and creativity.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Back Care Yoga Workshop ~ Live with Greater Ease — Sat Nov 14, 1:00 PM — Revolution Yoga- Lewis Studio
item.description:
**Back Care Yoga Workshop — Move with Greater Ease**
*"Your spine is your lifeline." — Denise Austin*
Give your back the attention it deserves!
After overcoming severe sciatica and finding lasting relief, experienced yoga instructor MaryEllen Whitton created this workshop with a mission: to share the knowledge and techniques that made such a profound difference in her own life.
**This workshop goes beyond the yoga mat!** Discover practical strategies, simple movements, and everyday habits to improve spinal mobility, release tension, build strength, and support a healthier back.
Learn how small changes in the way you sit, stand, and move can make a meaningful difference in how you feel.
**All levels welcome. No yoga experience necessary.**
Leave with greater awareness and practical tools to care for your spine every day.
Source: Press Democrat

**Yoga Nidra: An Invitation to Deep Rest**
Give yourself permission to pause, unwind, and experience the restorative power of deep relaxation.
Join experienced yoga and meditation instructor MaryEllen Whitton for a 90-minute experience combining gentle movement, breathwork, meditation, and Yoga Nidra—a guided practice designed to promote profound relaxation, calm the nervous system, and restore a sense of balance.
You'll be guided into a state of deep rest, allowing your body to relax while your mind remains gently aware. No previous yoga experience is necessary. Simply come as you are and give yourself the gift of stillness.

item.title: Marin Farmers Markets — Thu Nov 19, 8:00 AM — Marin Veterans' Memorial Auditorium
item.description:
Price: Free
Sponsor: Marin Center
Explore the bounty of summer at the Marin Farmers Markets. Taste vine-ripened tomatoes, corn that was picked that morning, and peaches so juicy you have to bend over just to get a bite. Farm-fresh eggs, grass-fed beef, artisan c heeses, raw milk, and freshly baked breads complete the shopping exper ience. Specialty prepared foods and handmade art add to the magic of the market.
Enjoy the intimate feeling of the Thursday Marin Farmers Market, an ideal place to meet for lunch and pick up fresh produce for the weekend. Discover the abundance and diversity of product at the celebrated Sunday Marin Farmers Market, the third largest farmers market in California. Turn your dollar into a vote for local sustainable agriculture, shrink your eco-footprint, and revive the feeling of being intimate ly connected to your food by meeting your farmers face-to-face. The market takes place rain or shine.
www.aginstitutemarin.org
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Dem

item.title: Meet Me in St. Louis — Fri Nov 20, 7:30 PM — 6th Street Playhouse
item.description: Meet Me in St. Louis is a heartwarming, nostalgic musical that brings the charm and excitement of turn-of-the-century America to life. Set in 1904 on the eve of the St. Louis World’s Fair, the story follows the Smith family through a year of romance, humor, and unexpected change. At its center is the spirited and lovestruck Esther Smith, whose blossoming romance unfolds alongside her sisters’ own adventures and the family’s hopes for the future. Featuring beloved songs like “The Trolley Song,” “Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas,” and “The Boy Next Door,” this classic musical overflows with warmth, wit, and unforgettable melodies. Rich with period detail, lively ensemble numbers, and tender family moments, Meet Me in St. Louis celebrates community, resilience, and the enduring power of home. Audiences will be swept up in its colorful seasonal settings—from summer dances to a magical Christmas Eve—culminating in the dazzling anticipation of the World’s Fair. Perfect for theatregoers

item.title: Meet Me in St. Louis — Sat Nov 21, 6:30 PM — 6th Street Playhouse
item.description: Meet Me in St. Louis is a heartwarming, nostalgic musical that brings the charm and excitement of turn-of-the-century America to life. Set in 1904 on the eve of the St. Louis World’s Fair, the story follows the Smith family through a year of romance, humor, and unexpected change. At its center is the spirited and lovestruck Esther Smith, whose blossoming romance unfolds alongside her sisters’ own adventures and the family’s hopes for the future. Featuring beloved songs like “The Trolley Song,” “Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas,” and “The Boy Next Door,” this classic musical overflows with warmth, wit, and unforgettable melodies. Rich with period detail, lively ensemble numbers, and tender family moments, Meet Me in St. Louis celebrates community, resilience, and the enduring power of home. Audiences will be swept up in its colorful seasonal settings—from summer dances to a magical Christmas Eve—culminating in the dazzling anticipation of the World’s Fair. Perfect for theatregoers
